title: Level of battery icon does not reflect actual state of a connected peripheral on a desktop computer with no built-in batteries
line: On a computer without a built-in battery, the Power and Battery icon now shows the real charge of a connected mouse, keyboard or headset instead of an always-full battery.
explanation: On a computer with no internal battery, any peripheral battery makes the widget a "Power & Battery" one, and in the default profile its compact icon fell back to Plasmoid.icon, a static "battery-full". The real level icon was only used for internal batteries, so the panel showed a full battery whatever the peripheral's charge. The compact representation now tracks the peripheral batteries from the model and, in the default profile without manual inhibition, shows the level (and charging state) of the emptiest one, including the percentage badge when that option is on.

commits.message:
applets/batterymonitor: show the peripheral battery level on desktops

Without internal batteries, a connected peripheral turned the panel icon
into a generic full battery that never reflected its charge. In the
default profile, the icon now shows the level of the emptiest peripheral.

BUG: 506732

patches.diff:
From e3be15970278a55d063a900490f100d836613d34 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 02:43:36 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/batterymonitor: show the peripheral battery level on
 desktops

Without internal batteries, a connected peripheral turned the panel icon
into a generic full battery that never reflected its charge. In the
default profile, the icon now shows the level of the emptiest peripheral.

BUG: 506732
---
 .../batterymonitor/CompactRepresentation.qml  | 43 +++++++++++++++----
 1 file changed, 35 insertions(+), 8 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/batterymonitor/CompactRepresentation.qml b/applets/batterymonitor/CompactRepresentation.qml
index 0a02b660f..d8c2a73a9 100644
--- a/applets/batterymonitor/CompactRepresentation.qml
+++ b/applets/batterymonitor/CompactRepresentation.qml
@@ -56,13 +56,40 @@ MouseArea {
             ? activeProfileIconSrc
             : Plasmoid.icon
 
+    // Without internal batteries, show the level of the emptiest peripheral battery in the default profile
+    readonly property QtObject peripheralBattery: {
+        let lowest = null;
+        for (let i = 0; i < peripheralBatteries.count; ++i) {
+            const battery = peripheralBatteries.objectAt(i);
+            if (battery && battery.percent >= 0 && (!lowest || battery.percent < lowest.percent)) {
+                lowest = battery;
+            }
+        }
+        return lowest;
+    }
+    readonly property bool showPeripheralBattery: !hasInternalBatteries && peripheralBattery !== null
+        && isInDefaultPowerProfile && !isManuallyInhibited
+
+    Instantiator {
+        id: peripheralBatteries
+
+        active: !root.hasInternalBatteries
+        model: root.model
+
+        delegate: QtObject {
+            required property var model
+            readonly property int percent: model.Percent
+            readonly property bool charging: model.ChargeState === BatteryControlModel.Charging
+        }
+    }
+
     // Shown for no batteries or manual inhibition while not discharging
     Kirigami.Icon {
         id: powerModeIcon
 
         anchors.fill: parent
 
-        visible: root.isConstrained && (!root.hasInternalBatteries || (root.isManuallyInhibited && !root.isDischarging))
+        visible: root.isConstrained && !root.showPeripheralBattery && (!root.hasInternalBatteries || (root.isManuallyInhibited && !root.isDischarging))
         source: root.powerModeIconSrc
         active: root.containsMouse
     }
@@ -72,7 +99,7 @@ MouseArea {
 
         anchors.fill: parent
 
-        visible: root.isConstrained && !powerModeIcon.visible && root.hasInternalBatteries
+        visible: root.isConstrained && !powerModeIcon.visible
 
         // Show normal battery icon
         WorkspaceComponents.BatteryIcon {
@@ -81,10 +108,10 @@ MouseArea {
             anchors.fill: parent
 
             active: root.containsMouse
-            hasBattery: root.hasCumulative
-            percent: root.batteryPercent
-            isSomehowFullyCharged: root.isSomehowFullyCharged
-            pluggedIn: root.batteryPluggedIn
+            hasBattery: root.hasCumulative || root.showPeripheralBattery
+            percent: root.showPeripheralBattery ? root.peripheralBattery.percent : root.batteryPercent
+            isSomehowFullyCharged: root.isSomehowFullyCharged && !root.showPeripheralBattery
+            pluggedIn: root.showPeripheralBattery ? root.peripheralBattery.charging : root.batteryPluggedIn
             preferSymbolic: true
             powerProfileIconName: root.isInDefaultPowerProfile ? ""
                                 : root.isInPowersaveProfile    ? "powersave"
@@ -99,9 +126,9 @@ MouseArea {
             anchors.right: parent.right
             anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
 
-            visible: Plasmoid.configuration.showPercentage && root.batteryPercent >= 0 && !root.isSomehowFullyCharged
+            visible: Plasmoid.configuration.showPercentage && overallBatteryIcon.percent >= 0 && !overallBatteryIcon.isSomehowFullyCharged
 
-            text: i18nc("battery percentage below battery icon", "%1%", root.batteryPercent)
+            text: i18nc("battery percentage below battery icon", "%1%", overallBatteryIcon.percent)
 
             // Non-default state to center if the badge is wider than the icon
             states: [
--

Same setup with the fix: the panel icon shows the mouse's 20%

review.text: Clean QML fix in powerdevil that resolves the misleading static full-battery icon on desktops without internal batteries by tracking peripheral batteries via an Instantiator and displaying the lowest-charged peripheral's level, charging state, and optional percentage badge in the default power profile. Reactivity on model count and live percentage changes is sound, laptop/profile/inhibition/desktop-grid paths remain intact, and the before/after screenshots clearly verify the behavior.

reviews.text: Clean QML fix in powerdevil that resolves the misleading static full-battery icon on desktops without internal batteries by tracking peripheral batteries via an Instantiator and displaying the lowest-charged peripheral's level, charging state, and optional percentage badge in the default power profile. Reactivity on model count and live percentage changes is sound, laptop/profile/inhibition/desktop-grid paths remain intact, and the before/after screenshots clearly verify the behavior.

It matches the current title and Nate's c6 intent: on a machine without internal batteries, the compact icon in the default profile now shows the real level and charging state of the emptiest peripheral instead of the static battery-full Plasmoid.icon. The change stays in CompactRepresentation.qml. Profile icons, manual inhibition, the no-peripheral speedometer and the laptop path still behave as before, and the badge now follows whichever battery the icon shows. Live updates and the regression matrix were checked on a dbusmock UPower rig. Minor nit: unlike the GridView delegate, the Instantiator ignores model.PluggedIn, so a not-present peripheral with a stale Percent could be chosen; not a blocker.
